description: The bar chart illustrates the effect of different multilingual BERT models (mBERT-L2, XLM-L2, mBERT-R2, XLM-R2, mBERT-B2, XLM-B2) on various morphosyntactic features: case, gender, tag, number, and tense. The vertical axis represents the effect, measured in a numerical scale, while the horizontal axis categorizes the features. Each bar is color-coded to represent a different model, with mBERT-L2 in light blue, XLM-L2 in dark blue, mBERT-R2 in green, XLM-R2 in red, mBERT-B2 in light green, and XLM-B2 in pink. The bars vary in height, indicating the magnitude of the effect, with some bars extending above the zero line, suggesting a positive effect, and others below, indicating a negative effect. Error bars are present on each bar, representing the variability or confidence interval of the effect. The chart does not provide specific values or units for the effect, but the error bars suggest a range of values for each model's effect on the morphosyntactic features.
